129: # 同时给 60 日区间与近 250 日分位，用来回答另一个问题：现价在这个区间里算贵还是便宜。
130: def price_ref(syms, base=BASE):
131:     """返回 symbol → px / vwap60 / lo60 / hi60 / pct250 / dev60。取不到就返回空表。"""
132:     import duckdb
133:     lst = ','.join("'" + s + "'" for s in syms)
134:     q = f"""
135:     with b as (
136:       select symbol, close, volume, amount,
137:              row_number() over (partition by symbol order by trade_date desc) rn,
138:              close as _ignore
139:         from daily_bars
140:        where symbol in ({lst}) and trade_date <= DATE '{base}'
141:     ), cur as (select symbol, max(case when rn = 1 then close end) px from b group by 1)
142:     select b.symbol,
143:            any_value(c.px) as px,
144:            round(sum(case when b.rn <= 60 then b.amount end)
145:                  / nullif(sum(case when b.rn <= 60 then b.volume end), 0), 4) as vwap60,
146:            min(case when b.rn <= 60 then b.close end) as lo60,
147:            max(case when b.rn <= 60 then b.close end) as hi60,
148:            round(100.0 * count(case when b.rn <= 250 and b.close <= c.px then 1 end)
149:                  / nullif(count(case when b.rn <= 250 then 1 end), 0), 1) as pct250
150:       from b join cur c using (symbol)
151:      group by 1
152:     """

159:         return pd.DataFrame()
160:     df['dev60'] = (df.px / df.vwap60 - 1) * 100
161:     return df.set_index('symbol')

25: def _fill_metrics(mem):
26:     """为新成员从湖内补齐 yld/pay/ocfd/amt（复用 annual_review 底层口径）。"""
27:     import duckdb, importlib
28:     ar = importlib.import_module('annual_review')
29:     con = duckdb.connect(':memory:')
30:     con.execute(f"ATTACH '{_LAKE}' AS src (read_only)")
31:     syms = mem.sym.tolist()
32:     y_now = ar.infer_year(con)
33:     y0, y2 = y_now - 3, y_now - 1
34:     div = ar.load_dividend(con, syms)
35:     dps_ttm = ar.ttm_dps(div, BASE, syms)          # Series idx by symbol
36:     fin = ar.load_fin(con, syms, y0, y2)           # cols symbol,y,np_yi,ocf_yi
37:     divy = ar.div_by_year(div, y0, y2)             # cols symbol,y,dps,amt_yi
38:     amt = ar.load_amount(con, syms, BASE, 63)      # cols symbol,amt_wan
39:     fin_g = fin.groupby('symbol')[['np_yi', 'ocf_yi']].sum()
40:     div_g = divy.groupby('symbol')['amt_yi'].sum()
41:     amt_s = amt.set_index('symbol')['amt_wan']
42:     pxmap = mem.set_index('sym')['px'].to_dict() if 'px' in mem.columns else {}
43:     out = {}
44:     for s in syms:
45:         _dttm = float(dps_ttm.get(s, 0) or 0)
46:         _px = float(pxmap.get(s, float('nan')))
47:         _yld = _dttm / _px * 100 if _px and _px == _px and _px != 0 else float('nan')
48:         _div3 = float(div_g.get(s, float('nan')))
49:         _np3 = float(fin_g['np_yi'].get(s, float('nan')) if s in fin_g.index else float('nan'))
50:         _ocf3 = float(fin_g['ocf_yi'].get(s, float('nan')) if s in fin_g.index else float('nan'))
51:         _pay = _div3 / _np3 * 100 if _np3 and _np3 == _np3 and _np3 != 0 else float('nan')
52:         _ocfd = _ocf3 / _div3 if _div3 and _div3 == _div3 and _div3 != 0 else float('nan')
53:         _amt = float(amt_s.get(s, float('nan')))
54:         out[s] = dict(yld=_yld, pay=_pay, ocfd=_ocfd, amt=_amt)
55:     con.close()
56:     return out

    import duckdb, importlib

def _fill_metrics(mem):
    """为新成员从湖内补齐 yld/pay/ocfd/amt 及连续两年 payout2y/ocfd2y（与 annual_review 财年口径一致）。"""
    import duckdb, importlib
    ar = importlib.import_module('annual_review')
    con = duckdb.connect(':memory:')
    con.execute(f"ATTACH '{_LAKE}' AS src (read_only)")
    syms = mem.sym.tolist()
    y_now = ar.infer_year(con)
    y0, y2 = y_now - 3, y_now - 1
    div = ar.load_dividend(con, syms)
    dps_ttm = ar.ttm_dps(div, BASE, syms)          # Series idx by symbol
    fin = ar.load_fin(con, syms, y0, y2)           # cols symbol,y,np_yi,ocf_yi
    divy = ar.div_by_year(div, y0, y2)             # cols symbol,y,dps,amt_yi
    amt = ar.load_amount(con, syms, BASE, 63)      # cols symbol,amt_wan
    fin_g = fin.groupby('symbol')[['np_yi', 'ocf_yi']].sum()
    div_g = divy.groupby('symbol')['amt_yi'].sum()
    amt_s = amt.set_index('symbol')['amt_wan']
    pxmap = mem.set_index('sym')['px'].to_dict() if 'px' in mem.columns else {}
    out = {}
    for s in syms:
        _dttm = float(dps_ttm.get(s, 0) or 0)
        _px = float(pxmap.get(s, float('nan')))
        _yld = _dttm / _px * 100 if _px and _px == _px and _px != 0 else float('nan')
        _div3 = float(div_g.get(s, float('nan')))
        _np3 = float(fin_g['np_yi'].get(s, float('nan')) if s in fin_g.index else float('nan'))
        _ocf3 = float(fin_g['ocf_yi'].get(s, float('nan')) if s in fin_g.index else float('nan'))
        _pay = _div3 / _np3 * 100 if _np3 and _np3 == _np3 and _np3 != 0 else float('nan')
        _ocfd = _ocf3 / _div3 if _div3 and _div3 == _div3 and _div3 != 0 else float('nan')
        _amt = float(amt_s.get(s, float('nan')))
        # 连续两年：按财年合并净利/OCF/分红额，单年支付率% 与 OCF/分红
        payout2y, ocfd2y = None, None
        f_s = fin[fin.symbol == s].drop(columns='symbol').set_index('y')
        d_s = divy[divy.symbol == s].drop(columns='symbol').set_index('y')
        if len(f_s) or len(d_s):
            g = f_s.join(d_s[['amt_yi']], how='outer')
            pay_y = (g['amt_yi'] / g['np_yi'] * 100).where(
                g['np_yi'].notna() & (g['np_yi'] != 0) & g['amt_yi'].notna())
            ocfd_y = (g['ocf_yi'] / g['amt_yi']).where(
                g['amt_yi'].notna() & (g['amt_yi'] != 0) & g['ocf_yi'].notna())
            ok = pay_y.notna() & ocfd_y.notna()
            yrs = g.index[ok].sort_values()
            if len(yrs) >= 2:
                y2s = yrs[-2:]
                payout2y = [round(float(pay_y.loc[y]), 2) for y in y2s]
                ocfd2y = [round(float(ocfd_y.loc[y]), 2) for y in y2s]
        out[s] = dict(
            yld=_yld, pay=_pay, ocfd=_ocfd, amt=_amt,
            payout2y=payout2y, ocfd2y=ocfd2y)
    con.close()
    return out
